phaseTitle: Workflow Router Screen Correction and Guided Current Action UI
purpose: Durable phase-local register for Operator observations, carry-forward items, deferred UI issues, and product-scope notes discovered during Phase 03 validation.

governanceRule.summary: Every Operator validation observation must receive an Architect disposition. The phase register records discovery and triage. Any observation not fully resolved inside Phase 03 must also be represented in the project-level register.
governanceRule.phaseCloseoutRequirement: Phase closeout must confirm all phase observations are Resolved, No action required, or represented in the Project Observation Register.

openObservations.title: Validation checklist should become editable / structured
openObservations.operatorObservation: The manual validation checklist should move to the top of the Operator validation record, become editable, or become pass/fail/skipped questions so the validation record does not duplicate What was tested and checklist content.
openObservations.architectDisposition: Defer to later validation-record workflow work.
openObservations.dispositionRationale: This is real validation UX debt, but it is not blocking WC07 Artifact Review Workspace. It is more directly related to validation record authoring and the later validation/repair route work.
openObservations.assignedTarget: WC12 — Operator Validation Record and REPAIR Sub-Card Route, or post-Phase-03 validation UX cleanup if WC12 scope is kept narrower.

openObservations.title: Screenshot paste and evidence UI needs cleanup
openObservations.operatorObservation: Screenshot paste should be the primary input method, the attach button should be fallback, repo-relative paths should clear after image creation, and screenshot evidence should be shown more like an image/card rather than long path text.
openObservations.architectDisposition: Defer to later validation-record workflow work.
openObservations.dispositionRationale: Screenshot input improved enough for prior repair validation to pass, but the remaining issue is broader validation-evidence UX rather than WC07 artifact review.
openObservations.assignedTarget: WC12 — Operator Validation Record and REPAIR Sub-Card Route, or post-Phase-03 UI cleanup.

openObservations.title: Multi-project / workspace support does not exist
openObservations.operatorObservation: There is no way currently to work multiple projects through the application.
openObservations.architectDisposition: Transfer to product backlog / future phase.
openObservations.dispositionRationale: Multi-project/workspace management is valid product functionality but outside Phase 03 router UI correction.

openObservations.title: Top workflow/action bars and Supporting Tools are duplicative and consume workspace real estate
openObservations.operatorObservation: Action bar remains duplicative and cluttered. Supporting Tools menu is duplicative of the action bar. Action bar should be collapsible or minimizable in some way to return real estate to the workspace.
openObservations.architectDisposition: Defer to later Phase 03 navigation/layout pass.
openObservations.dispositionRationale: This is a valid global navigation/readability issue, but it is not a WC07-REPAIR01 blocker because the repair target was artifact workspace layout ownership, left-panel simplification, preview usability, support/current-action separation, and validation-form accessibility. Collapsing or redesigning the top workflow/action bars would affect WC06 workflow visibility and WC05 support navigation and should be handled as its own scoped Work Card or later UI consolidation pass.
openObservations.assignedTarget: Later Phase 03 navigation/layout cleanup Work Card or post-Phase-03 UI consolidation pass.

resolvedObservations.title: Source Evidence should not show full raw paths
Supporting screens are reachable but not populated
resolvedObservations.status: Resolved for WC07 scope / residual route-specific screen population deferred by scope
resolvedObservations.projectRegisterLink: Not promoted as open item; resolved for WC07 scope. Reopen as a new project observation only if later route-specific screen work requires it.
